name: JS_SISTEM_2
summary: JS_SISTEM_2 is a trend-following expert advisor that uses a combination of moving average-based indicators and momentum filters to identify and enter trending market conditions. The EA systematically opens positions when trend direction aligns across multiple confirmations, employing fixed lot sizing and stop-loss/take-profit for trade management. It operates primarily on higher timeframes to capture sustained directional moves.
summary_zh: JS_SISTEM_2是一个趋势跟踪型智能交易系统，结合均线类指标和动量过滤器来识别并进入趋势行情。该EA在多重确认趋势方向一致时系统性地开仓，采用固定手数和止损/止盈进行交易管理，主要在较高时间周期上运行以捕捉持续的方向性行情。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是趋势跟踪，利用均线系统判断市场主趋势方向。入场条件要求多个均线或趋势指标确认方向一致性，例如快慢均线金叉/死叉配合动量指标过滤。出场条件包括固定止损止盈和趋势反转信号，当均线交叉反向或动量衰竭时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户余额动态调整，资金管理较为简单。整体策略逻辑清晰，但缺少对震荡行情的过滤机制，可能在盘整市中产生频繁假信号。止损设置虽然有但可能不够灵活，未考虑市场波动率的动态调整。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following, utilizing a moving average system to determine the primary market trend direction. Entry conditions require multiple moving average or trend indicators to confirm directional consistency, such as fast/slow MA crossovers combined with momentum filter confirmation. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels as well as trend reversal signals, closing positions when MA crosses in the opposite direction or momentum fades. Position sizing employs a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account balance, making money management relatively simplistic. The overall strategy logic is clear, but lacks a ranging market filter which may generate frequent false signals during consolidation periods. While stop-losses are implemented, they may not be flexible enough as they do not account for dynamic market volatility adjustments such as ATR-based stops.
pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于均线趋势跟踪的经典方法，易于理解和验证
设有固定止损止盈，具备基本的风险控制机制，不会出现无限亏损
多重确认入场减少了假信号，提高了趋势识别的可靠性
系统化执行消除了人为情绪干扰，保持交易纪律一致性
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on classic moving average trend following, easy to understand and verify
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit provide basic risk control, preventing unlimited losses
Multiple confirmation entry reduces false signals and improves trend identification reliability
Systematic execution eliminates emotional interference, maintaining consistent trading discipline
cons: 固定手数仓位管理未考虑账户规模和波动率，资金利用率不够优化
缺少震荡行情过滤机制，在盘整市场中容易产生连续假突破亏损
止损止盈为固定点数，未根据ATR等波动率指标动态调整，适应性不足
缺少加仓和减仓机制，无法在趋势发展中优化持仓成本和利润
cons_en: Fixed lot position sizing does not account for account size or volatility, leading to suboptimal capital utilization
Lacks a ranging market filter, prone to consecutive false breakout losses during consolidation
Fixed pip stop-loss and take-profit are not dynamically adjusted based on ATR or volatility, limiting adaptability
No position scaling mechanism, unable to optimize entry cost and profit during trend development
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自动调整止损距离，提高适应性
增加震荡行情识别过滤器（如ADX或布林带宽度），在盘整期减少或暂停交易
实现基于账户余额百分比的动态仓位管理，优化资金利用率和风险回报比
improvements_en: Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit that automatically adjusts based on market volatility for better adaptability
Add a ranging market identification filter (such as ADX or Bollinger Band width) to reduce or pause trading during consolidation periods
Implement percentage-based dynamic position sizing based on account balance to optimize capital utilization and risk-reward ratio

risk_points: 固定手数仓位管理在小型账户中风险集中，大型账户中资金利用率低
缺少震荡行情过滤可能在横盘期产生连续亏损
固定止损可能在高波动市场中被轻易触发造成不必要损失
risk_points_en: Fixed lot sizing concentrates risk in small accounts and underutilizes capital in large accounts
Lack of ranging market filter may cause consecutive losses during sideways markets
Fixed stop-loss may be easily triggered in high volatility markets causing unnecessary losses

The EA systematically opens positions when trend direction aligns across multiple confirmations, employing fixed lot sizing and stop-loss/take-profit for trade management. It operates primarily on higher timeframes to capture sustained directional moves.
